sources.entry: Codex Quota Overlay - Independent desktop companion showing Codex quota, reset time, and reset credits beside the conversation title on Windows and macOS. #free #opensource

summary.one_liner: A Windows (and macOS source-build) desktop overlay that shows Codex quota, reset time, and reset credits beside the Codex conversation title, with a local Quota Center dashboard.
keywords: see how much codex quota is left
summary.what_it_does: The app runs in the Windows notification area or macOS menu bar and reads the local Codex App Server's account/rateLimits/read method to show the current limit beside the Codex conversation title. It lists every reported rate-limit bucket with its primary and secondary windows, plus reset countdown and reset-credit count when provided. A Quota Center dashboard estimates recent burn rate, a safe pace to the next reset, possible exhaustion time, and forecast confidence from current-cycle samples. It can also summarize activity totals via account/usage/read when available. The overlay appears only while Codex Desktop is active and never takes focus or intercepts pointer input. Quota history stays in memory unless the user enables 7/14/30/90-day persistence, and alerts are off by default.
use_cases: check remaining Codex quota while working
see when the Codex rate limit resets
track Codex usage pace and forecast exhaustion
get alerts when Codex quota drops below thresholds
how_to_run: Windows: download CodexQuotaOverlay-Windows-Setup-*-x64.exe from GitHub Releases and run the installer (or extract the portable ZIP).
Launch the app; its icon stays in the notification area.
Source build: install Node.js 24 and npm, then run `npm ci`.
Package with `.\package.ps1` on Windows (requires Inno Setup 6), or `npm run dist:mac` on macOS.
notable: Shows every reported rate-limit bucket and its primary/secondary windows rather than collapsing to one value
Pace, forecast, and exhaustion-time estimates from current-cycle samples
Never captures screenshots or reads conversation titles; window probe leaves title empty
Session-only history by default; optional persistence stores only normalized percentages and timestamps
Short diagnostic codes (at most 200 characters) without account, path, or token data
caveats: Windows 10/11 x64 is the only distributed platform in version 0.4.0; macOS has no release binary and is source-build only
Quota data requires a ChatGPT-managed Codex sign-in; API-key-only configurations may not expose it
The Windows package is not commercially code-signed
No official Codex Desktop app exists for Linux, so no Linux packages are published
